install_tell: ClickHouse Keeper config block (<keeper_server>) in config.xml, or standalone clickhouse-keeper binary; often co-located on the same host as ClickHouse itself (distinct process/port from the 8123/9000 HTTP/native interfaces already tracked under platform 'clickhouse')
misconfig_patterns: Password auth is OPTIONAL — ships with none configured; operator must explicitly set CLICKHOUSE_KEEPER_PASSWORD or XML password field

Ships as ZooKeeper 4lw-command-compatible drop-in replacement — same unauth 4lw exposure class as ZooKeeper itself, on a different default port (9181 vs 2181), so port-2181-only ZK dorks miss this population entirely
Often deployed to REPLACE ZooKeeper for a ClickHouse cluster — operators who hardened their ZK ensemble frequently forget Keeper is the same exposure class under a new name/port

Overlap note: base ClickHouse HTTP interface (8123/9000, tracked in tome as 'clickhouse', category vector_feature) is a SEPARATE listener from Keeper (9181) — a host can show one without the other; do not conflate the two dork sets

active_probe.false_positive_check: raw TCP 'ruok' 4lw write must return exactly 'imok' -- shared with ZK-compatible 4lw servers generally, so confirm platform with 'srvr'/'stat' response format (ClickHouse Keeper's stat output differs in banner text from Java ZooKeeper -- look for absence of 'Zookeeper version:' JVM-style string and presence of ClickHouse build info instead)

deployment_tells: raw TCP 'mntr' to :9181 returns Keeper metrics (zk_followers-style keys, some ClickHouse-specific) without auth
raw TCP 'stat' response format differs from Java ZK banner (no JVM version string) -- distinguishes Keeper from real ZooKeeper on a relocated port

co-occurrence with ClickHouse HTTP (8123 'Ok.') on the SAME ip is a strong operator-linkage signal but not required -- Keeper can run standalone as pure coordination backend for a ClickHouse cluster whose data nodes are elsewhere
pivot_paths: 4lw 'wchs'/'cons' -> connected ClickHouse data-node IPs -> pivots to the actual cluster this Keeper coordinates
'conf' 4lw -> Raft cluster member list -> full Keeper ensemble topology unauth
if co-located with ClickHouse HTTP 8123, cross-pivot to SHOW CREATE TABLE / system.tables per the 'clickhouse' tome entry
vulnerabilities: No CVE required — optional-password-by-default is a design-default finding
